planets.name: HD 101581 b
planets.description: HD 101581 b crosses its star every 4.47 days and is 0.96 times as wide as Earth, found in 2025.

text.card: HD 101581 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 56998. Its orbit and size follow Kunimoto et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
